title: Membership characterized by the final configuration
statement: Let $L$ be a language of Boolean words, let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over Boolean symbols, and let $c_0,c$ be natural numbers. Suppose $M$ decides $L$ within the time bound $n\mapsto c_0\,2^{n^c}$. Then for every Boolean word $x$, $x\in L$ if and only if, after $2^{(c_0+3)(|x|+1)^{c+1}}-1$ steps from its initial configuration on $x$, the machine is halted and its output register contains exactly the single bit $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language of Boolean words
$M$ is a finite Turing machine over Boolean symbols
